name: National Insurance Debt Notice
summary: Explains that unpaid contributions or a benefit recalculation left an outstanding balance, with payment, instalment, or objection steps.

guidance.primaryNextStep: Confirm the reason for the debt, then either pay, ask for instalments, or dispute it in writing right away.
guidance.deadlineSummary: By the payment date on the notice
guidance.appliesWhen: unpaid national insurance contributions or a recalculation created an outstanding balance
guidance.recommendedChannel: Respond through the branch or payment route printed on the notice and keep the receipt or case reference.
guidance.whenToContactAuthority: you already paid, the debt reason is wrong, or you need an instalment plan before the deadline
guidance.whatToVerify: Verify the charged period, reason for the debt, total amount due, and the last payment date.

sections.explainer: Case number and charge period: identify the account and months covered by the debt.
Reason for the debt: check whether the amount relates to contributions, employer reporting or recalculation of a benefit.
sections.actionRequired: Compare the reason with payslips, account deductions and previous benefit letters.

sections.explainer: Amount due: clarify the debt components and whether previous payments or deductions were credited.
Final payment date: the date on your own notice. Unresolved debt may lead to additional charges or collection.
sections.actionRequired: After checking the debt, use the official payment details and keep the receipt.
sections.deadline: By the payment date on the notice

sections.explainer: Instalments or a dispute: check how to apply if the amount is wrong or cannot be paid at once. Instalments may carry interest.
sections.actionRequired: If you need instalments or dispute the debt, contact the branch and keep your written request and evidence.
sections.deadline: As early as possible; check the notice deadline

sources.title: ביטוח לאומי — חוב בדמי ביטוח
sources.scope: Explains contribution debt, potential additional charges, contacting a branch and payment arrangements. Benefit-overpayment cases may follow different procedures.

sources.title: ביטוח לאומי — חובות עובדים עצמאיים ומי שאינם עובדים
sources.scope: Lists official contribution-debt payment channels and notes that instalments carry interest; terms depend on the case.
